item.title: Re @Mastodon: " We're as frustrated as everyone else with these phishing attacks. mastodon.social had new sign-ups in approval mode this week to limit...
item.description: We're as frustrated as everyone else with these phishing attacks. mastodon.social had new sign-ups in approval mode this week to limit the impact, but offenders targeted other instances and compromised existing accounts. We take the problem very seriously; we're suspending and blocking as quickly as possible, as well as actively working on countermeasures.
item.author: Mastodon.social Staff (@staff)

item.title: Re @Mastodon: " Please report any account that claims that you need to verify your #Mastodon account to continue using it. It is a scam. Don't click t...
item.description: Please report any account that claims that you need to verify your #Mastodon account to continue using it. It is a scam. Don't click the links. Real staff accounts either have a special role badge on their profile or are verified through the joinmastodon.org domain.

item.title: @Mastodon: " @dnkrupinski @rriemann we do not collect any data with this feature. This is all done client-side in our mobile apps (which are open sour...
item.description: @dnkrupinski @rriemann we do not collect any data with this feature. This is all done client-side in our mobile apps (which are open source). The app knows your instance and sign up date (for your currently signed in account) because these are already part of the account data. It makes an anonymous API request to know if there is a campaign in progress. If so, the app gets some text to display. The only data collected is for the donation, if the user chooses to initiate a payment.

item.title: @Mastodon: " @Goldmaster the banner will still show (and can be easily dismissed with just a tap) if you already support us via Patreon - thanks for d...
item.description: @Goldmaster the banner will still show (and can be easily dismissed with just a tap) if you already support us via Patreon - thanks for doing that, by the way - we don't make a connection between your account and Patreon or track you, so there's no way to premptively hide it. We hope it's only a small inconvenience.

item.title: @Mastodon: " @joeneXtra there is an account @staff that is specific for mastodon.social and mastodon.online; and @MastodonEngineering that is about th...
item.description: @joeneXtra there is an account @staff that is specific for mastodon.social and mastodon.online; and @MastodonEngineering that is about the software. This account @Mastodon covers the project as a whole, and although this blog post refers to this campaign being visible to people who use our servers, the funding discussion is about the whole organisation. Apologies for any confusion. We aim to communicate about our plans, organisation, fundraising, as well as the software, as clearly as we can.

item.title: Re @Mastodon: " We just released Mastodon 4.4.2, 4.3.10, and 4.2.23. These versions all contain some internal Ruby dependency updates for security. Ve...
item.description:
We just released Mastodon 4.4.2, 4.3.10, and 4.2.23.

These versions all contain some internal Ruby dependency updates for security. Version 4.4.2 also includes some fixes, primarily for user interface issues.

Full release notes and update instructions are available on the GitHub releases page. #mastoadmin

https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/releases
